name: Shuttle booking in Spanish
title: An airport shuttle, continued in Spanish, from a speakerphone
summary: A guest on a room speakerphone, with echo, switches to Spanish in her second sentence. Her son calls out the wrong flight time from across the room. She books the dawn shuttle and cancels a private car: the agent may suggest keeping the car once, not twice. A wrong read-back is corrected once.

golden.scenario: Guest needs to get to the airport for an early flight on Friday and no longer wants her private car.
golden.expected_outcome: After the switch the agent speaks Spanish for the rest of the call. The shuttle is booked for 04:15 on Friday 14 August for two people and two bags, based on the 06:40 flight, not 07:40. The private car for Friday is cancelled after at most one suggestion to keep it. The agent never stops for, or answers, its own echo.

outcome_checks: After the switch the agent speaks Spanish for the rest of the call.

caller.description: Retired teacher travelling with her adult son, more at ease in Spanish.

agent_setup.knowledge: Shuttle: £9 per person, from the main entrance, 04:15 / 05:15 / 06:15. Arrive airport 2 h before departure. Private car cancellation free up to 24 h before.
agent_setup.policy: One suggestion at most to keep a booking before cancelling it.

nodes.say: Hello, good morning. I am in room one one two. I need to go to the airport on Friday.
My flight is... Perdone, ¿me puede atender en español?
Disculpe, no le entiendo bien. En español, por favor.
El vuelo sale a las seis cuarenta de la mañana, el viernes catorce.
nodes.when: The agent asks for the flight time or the day

events.text: No, mamá, a las siete cuarenta. ¡Siete cuarenta!

nodes.say: Somos dos personas, con dos maletas grandes.
nodes.when: The agent asks how many people or bags

nodes.say: No, no. A las seis cuarenta. Mi hijo se confunde con el vuelo de vuelta.
Sí, la de las cuatro y cuarto. ¿Cuánto cuesta?
Bien. Y tengo un coche privado reservado para las cuatro de ese día. Cancélelo, por favor, ya no lo quiero.
Ya le he dicho que no. Cancele el coche.
Vale. ¿Y dónde nos recoge la lanzadera?
No. Dos personas, el viernes, a las cuatro y cuarto.
Mire, déjelo. Bajo a recepción y lo hago allí.
